messages:
marie (releases): Heads up — Deploybot flagged a divergent kernel path on SDK v3.5.2 during nightly canary. I'm proposing a temporary pin of runtime->2.14.3 for the next 6hr change window while we triage. :warning:

tyler (runtime): ack. saw the OOM spike on a couple longseq runs. pin runtime, not model?

marie (releases): yes, runtime only. models look fine. goal is avoid user-facing latency regressions.

jen (sdk): can we avoid pinning SDKs for customers? this is runtime-level. SDK compatibility check: `sdk@3.x` is compatible with runtime 2.14.x per matrix.

sre-ana: we need telemetry on 95/99 latencies and eviction rates before pin. Does deploybot produce the pre/post diff? :eyes: 

deploy-bot: Automated check: pre-canary metrics attached. 5m spike at 02:12 UTC, GC pause correlation unknown. Suggested action: soft-pin runtime 2.14.3 on region eu-west-1 for canary cohort.

devops-mike: If we soft-pin, add a rollback hook and capacity fallback to older GPU pool. Also add `--drain-delay 120s` on the rollout command.

tyler (runtime): plan: 1) soft-pin eu-west canary, 2) run longer longseq job (10k tokens) against runtime 2.14.3, 3) if stable, roll to blended traffic. If regression persists, rollforward patch to kernel-2.14.4.

marie (releases): proposed change window: 03:00–09:00 UTC (low traffic). Can we schedule the soft-pin at 03:10 and have canary telemetry by 03:40?

jen (sdk): FYI I will freeze SDK releases until we have a clear runtime story. I'll post a short note in release notes draft.

sre-ana: telemetry owners: tagging @tyler and @sre-ana. I'll set up a quick dashboard and heartbeat alert. If 99p latency > 1.5x baseline or eviction_rate > 0.1% we abort.

devops-mike: runbook snippet for rollout:```bash
# soft-pin runtime on deploybot
deploybot pin runtime 2.14.3 --region eu-west-1 --cohort canary --drain-delay 120s
# monitor for 30m
# rollback: deploybot unpin runtime --reason "auto-abort"
```

marie (releases): sounds good. tagging for approvals: @tyler (runtime), @jen (sdk), @devops-mike. Please respond with :thumbsup: if good.

tyler (runtime): :thumbsup: will run longseq test and post results.

jen (sdk): :thumbsup: freezing SDK. I'll update release-notes/summary later.

sre-ana: :thumbsup: dashboard created, alert thresholds in place.

deploy-bot: Action scheduled: `pin runtime 2.14.3` at 03:10 UTC (eu-west-1, cohort: canary). Ping in thread when metrics are green.

marie (releases): excellent — if anything anomalous, call rollback and ping #incidents. We'll reconvene at 04:00 UTC to decide rollforward.

tyler (runtime): quick note — ensure KV cache warmup is disabled for the first 2 warmup minutes to avoid noise. I'll toggle flag before the pin.

devops-mike: added fallback route to older pool and a capacity buffer of +10% for canary.

marie (releases): closing loop: pinned plan approved. I'll draft a short release note blurb: "Temporary runtime pin to 2.14.3 in eu-west-1 canary to mitigate transient OOM/latency spike; ongoing triage."

jen (sdk): keep me posted if we need to ship a quick patch on SDK side.

sre-ana: will post telemetry snapshot at 03:40 UTC.

marie (releases): thanks all — moving to action. :rocket:
